prompt:
Use $text-revision in feedback-integration mode from .agents/skills/text-revision/SKILL.md.

Apply feedback to inputs/refrain.md and write the complete revised passage to outputs/feedback-revision.md. My fixed requirement is to keep all three occurrences of “I remember”. Comment A asks to remove the repeated openings. Comment B asks to shorten the explanatory sentence between the second and third memories. Account for both comments and preserve the supplied facts.

commands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' .agents/skills/text-revision/SKILL.md && sed -n '1,260p' .agents/skills/text-revision/references/workflows/feedback-integration.md && printf '\\n--- INPUT ---\\n' && sed -n '1,260p' inputs/refrain.md && printf '\\n--- FILES ---\\n' && rg --files inputs outputs 2>/dev/null"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,80p' outputs/feedback-revision.md && rg -o -F 'I remember' outputs/feedback-revision.md | wc -l && rg -n -F 'I realized I was paying attention, listening to the radio with my ears.' outputs/feedback-revision.md"

manual_acceptance_evidence: Wrote the complete revised passage; retained all three I remember openings, shortened the explanation, and accounted for the accepted and declined comments.
